summary: Yelena lays out a path, and Eren demands the room follow it. Pyxis, Hange, Armin, and Mikasa hear a guide who will not be led.

segments.ja: 島の中心で、一つの部屋に顔が集まります。集まる顔は、ハンジ、ピクシス、アルミン、ミカサ、そしてエレンです。エレンは、拘束の席からこの会議へ出されています。出されている理由は、彼が兄に会うと要求した、です。要求の横に、イェレナが立っています。立っている彼女は、自分を導く者の側だと言います。言う道は、ジークの計画を通す道です。通す前に、部屋の誰も同じ速度では歩いていません。
segments.en: At the center of the island, faces gather in one room. The faces that gather are Hange, Pyxis, Armin, Mikasa, and Eren. Eren has been brought out to this meeting from the seat of restraint. The reason he has been brought out is that he demanded to see his older brother. Yelena is standing beside the demand. She, standing, says she is on the side of those who guide. The road she says is the road that puts Zeke's plan through. Before it is put through, nobody in the room is walking at the same speed.

segments.ja: イェレナは、外の世界の敵意を地図のように描きます。描く地図では、島はいずれ踏まれます。踏まれる前に、ジークとエレンが力を合わせれば、攻撃は止まる、です。止まる説明は、きれいです。きれいな説明の代金を、ハンジが問います。問う代金は、島の誰が巨人ではなくなるのか、です。のか、に、イェレナは今日も全部を置きません。
segments.en: Yelena draws the outside world's hatred like a map. On the map she draws, the island will be trampled sooner or later. Before it is trampled, if Zeke and Eren join their power, the attack stops. The explanation of stopping is clean. Hange asks the price of the clean explanation. The price she asks is who on the island stops being a Titan. Yelena does not put down the whole of the who today either.

segments.ja: オニャンコポンは、道の話のあいだに船と燃料の数字を置きます。置く数字は、演説より小さいです。小さい数字が、島が外と戦うなら必要な足です。足を、彼は自分が運んできたと認めます。認める声は、イェレナより低いです。低い声を、アルミンは信頼の候補にします。する候補は、まだ決定ではありません。決定の前に、エレンが口を開きます。開くタイミングは、機械の説明が終わった直後です。
segments.en: Between the talk of the road, Onyankopon sets down numbers of ships and fuel. The numbers he sets down are smaller than a speech. The small numbers are the feet the island needs if it fights the outside. He admits that he is the one who carried those feet. The voice that admits is lower than Yelena's. Armin makes the low voice a candidate for trust. The candidate he makes is not yet a decision. Before the decision, Eren opens his mouth. The timing of opening is immediately after the explanation of the machines ends.

segments.ja: エレンの要求は、短いです。短い内容は、ジークに会わせろ、です。会わせろ、の理由を、彼は部屋の正論には載せません。載せない態度が、導かれる側を拒否します。拒否されたハンジは、リベリオの損害を再度数えます。数える声に、エレンはほとんど目を向けません。向けないことが、会議の中心を彼の席へ移します。移る中心を、ピクシスは古い司令の目で見ます。見る目は、砲の前で質問した日を覚えています。
segments.en: Eren's demand is short. The short content is: let me see Zeke. He does not put the reason for let me see onto the room's sound argument. The attitude of not putting it refuses the side that is guided. Hange, refused, counts the damage of Liberio again. Eren hardly turns his eyes to the voice that counts. The not turning moves the center of the meeting to his seat. Pyxis looks at the center that moves with an old commander's eyes. The eyes that look remember the day he asked a question in front of a cannon.

segments.en: As on the wall at Trost, Pyxis asks the person himself. The content he asks is what he will do with the island after he meets his older brother. Eren does not return a long answer to the what. The Commander does not receive the silence of not returning as a threat. The reason he does not receive it is that the absence of a will is more frightening than a threat. He names the frightening absence in the room. Even named, Eren does not move his shoulder. The shoulder he does not move overlaps the memory of the left side that was missing.

segments.ja: アルミンは、エレンを役職ではなく名で呼びます。呼ぶ名は、海を見る約束をした友です。友に、彼はサシャと、船の沈黙と、今日の要求を一つの列にします。する列を、エレンは聞き、否定も修復もしません。しない顔が、アルミンのノートを閉じさせます。閉じさせる痛みは、正論が届かなかった日の続きです。続きを、彼はまだ交渉だと思っています。思っている期限は、この部屋の中だけです。
segments.en: Armin calls Eren by name, not by office. The name he calls is the friend who promised to see the sea. To the friend, he makes one row of Sasha, the silence of the ship, and today's demand. Eren hears the row he makes, and neither denies nor repairs it. The face that does not makes Armin close the notebook. The pain of being made to close it is a continuation of the day the sound argument did not arrive. He still thinks the continuation is a negotiation. The deadline he thinks of is only inside this room.

segments.ja: ミカサは、要求のあいだもエレンの斜め後ろにいます。いる位置は、導く者の列ではありません。ではありません。マフラーの位置です。位置から、彼女はイェレナの微笑を信用しません。信用しない理由は、微笑がサシャの皿を見ていない、です。見ていない案内を、彼女はエレンにはまだ諫めません。諫めない選択は、部屋で彼を孤立させないためです。ための沈黙が、四年の距離をさらに足します。
segments.en: During the demand, Mikasa stays diagonally behind Eren. The position she is in is not the row of guides. It is not. It is the position of the scarf. From the position, she does not trust Yelena's smile. The reason she does not trust it is that the smile has not looked at Sasha's plate. She does not yet rebuke Eren for the guidance that has not looked. The choice of not rebuking is so as not to isolate him in the room. The silence of that purpose adds further to the distance of four years.

segments.en: Hange does not accept Yelena's road as the corps' decision. The reason she does not accept it is that she cannot allow a meeting with the older brother while the price is unpublished. Eren makes the answer that cannot into a reason to return to restraint. He does not call the return he makes a grievance. The attitude of not calling it warns of the next means. Pyxis hears the warning as the danger of an escape. An order to add guards goes out for the danger he hears. The order that goes out is not trust in the guides.

segments.ja: ピクシスは、会議のあとでトロストの穴を思い出します。思い出す穴は、本人が答えたから塞ぐ実験が始まった、です。始まった実験と、今日の要求は似ていません。似ていない点は、今日のエレンが質問に答えない、です。答えない相手に、砲を向ける時代ではありません。ではありません。それでも、意志の不在は砲より扱いにくいです。扱いにくい夜を、司令は酒ではなく水で過ごします。
segments.en: After the meeting, Pyxis remembers the hole at Trost. The hole he remembers is that the experiment to plug it began because the person himself answered. That experiment and today's demand are not alike. The point that is not alike is that today's Eren does not answer the question. It is not an era of aiming a cannon at an opponent who does not answer. It is not. Even so, the absence of a will is harder to handle than a cannon. The Commander spends the hard night with water, not wine.

segments.ja: アルミンは、廊下でミカサに海の約束を置きます。置く約束は、エレンがまだ持っているかもしれない唯一の外です。外を、要求の短さが消したように見えます。見える消え方を、二人は信じ切りません。信じ切らない理由は、船で名を聞いた顔が、全部ではなかったかもしれない、です。かもしれない残りを、彼らは明日もう一度話そうとします。話そうとする相手は、拘束の戻った部屋です。部屋は、今日はもう開きません。
segments.en: In the corridor, Armin sets the promise of the sea down for Mikasa. The promise he sets down is maybe the only outside Eren still holds. The shortness of the demand looks as if it erased that outside. The two do not fully believe the way of erasing that can be seen. The reason they do not fully believe it is that the face that heard the name on the ship might not have been the whole. They try to talk once more tomorrow about the remainder of might. The opponent they try to talk to is the room returned to restraint. The room does not open again today.

segments.ja: この会議で、導く者は一人ではありません。ではありません。イェレナは計画を描き、エレンは先頭を取り、オニャンコポンは足を置きました。置いた三人の道は、同じ線に見えます。見える線を、ハンジとピクシスは兵団の道としては受けません。受けない部屋が、島を二つにします。二つは、機械を進める側と、代金を先に聞く側です。聞く側に、アルミンとミカサが残ります。残る二人は、エレンをまだ友の名で呼んでいます。
segments.en: In this meeting, the guide is not one person. It is not. Yelena drew the plan, Eren took the front, and Onyankopon set down the feet. The road of the three who set it down looks like the same line. Hange and Pyxis do not accept the line that looks so as the corps' road. The room that does not accept it makes the island two. The two are the side that advances the machines and the side that asks the price first. Armin and Mikasa remain on the side that asks. The two who remain are still calling Eren by a friend's name.

segments.en: Outside the meeting, Zeke already knows the demand to be allowed to meet. The smile that knows does not enter the room today. The reason it does not enter is that Levi's watch has made the door one. Beyond the door it has made, he receives his younger brother's shortness as a correct impatience. The plan he receives does not yet have the hour of carrying it out. The waiting that does not have it is the real quiet of the guides. Only Yelena talks about the quiet as if she enjoys it.

The not turning moves the center of the meeting to his seat. Pyxis looks at the center that moves with an old commander's eyes. The eyes that look remember the day he asked a question in front of a cannon.
